description: Edit a track point on a layer's tracker (created by start_tracking track_motion): Feature Center, Feature Size, Search Offset, Search Size, Attach Point and Attach Point Offset, in pixels. With a time, or when the property is already keyframed, it sets a keyframe; otherwise the static value

attachPointOffset.description: Attach Point Offset [x, y] from the feature centre

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

layers.description: The layer: one index (1-based, from list_layers), name, or selected: true

point.description: Track point index (1-based) or name, e.g. "Track Point 1". Default 1

searchOffset.description: Search Offset [x, y] from the feature centre

time.description: Set keyframes at this time in seconds

tracker.description: Tracker index (1-based) or name, e.g. "Tracker 1". Default 1

name: set_track_point
title: Set Track Point
